spectral_scattering.input: Current T1 native long/short logpower float16->float32, no resizing, fixed coefficients, all paths mean/std spatial grid

config.selection: 0.5*original Val group_macro +0.5*mean(10dB,0dB Val group_macro); tie mean10/0ACC then originalACC; actual trained checkpoints only, epoch0 reference not fallback
config.training: Four fresh public networks, semantically common weights identical; source T1 feature encoder frozen and eval F0, fixed spectral2D F1. Same waveforms/epoch noise/order/dropout, original50/10dB25/5dB10/0dB15. Raw Single no envelope; noisy Single retains existing envelope. No weakSNR training/select; no newauxheads.
config.initialization: No pretrained public classifier weights. Source checkpoint used ONLY for frozen feature extraction and kept T1 reference. M0 retains coupled7set/count readout and same loss, removes cross interaction and gater only.

normalization_rationale: Both combined-view mean/std fitted on all original raw Train only; frozen afterwards.
